strings.name: Kelly Slater
strings.summary: Slater grew from Florida beach surfing into an eleven-time world champion, influencing professional surfing through adaptation, tube riding and longevity. His first world title came in 1992 and eleventh in 2011; he won Pipeline again just before turning 50 in 2022. After losing regular full-tour qualification, he continued through wildcards and pursued surf-equipment and sustainable-clothing ventures.
